## 1 Trigger

A fire alarm from the covered market or a report of smoke in Market Ward triggers this procedure. The duty
officer dispatches the nearest fire crew and closes Market Street to traffic.

## 2 Evacuation of stalls

Stall holders leave through the north and east gates. The assembly point is the Market Ward bus stand. Crews
sweep the market in pairs and report each aisle clear.
